description: Permanently delete a file or folder on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Deleting a folder removes everything inside it. There is no undo and no recycle bin, so the only recovery is a backup. Requires `confirm: true`; always show the user the exact path and, for folders, what it contains before setting it.

confirm.description: Must be set to true. This operation is irreversible, so list the folder's contents and get explicit user approval before setting this.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

path.description: File or folder to delete, from the instance root. Deleting a folder is recursive.

name: delete_path
title: Delete File or Folder
